entries: Mind yourself. This is a holy thing.
Let's deal with that after we lift this curse. Perhaps more memories come to us.
等我们解除这诅咒，再来处理那件事吧。也许到那时我们会想起更多。
I don't believe you ever stopped.
我看，你从来就没停下过。
@... I suspect it was not a sheep that you were looking for.
@……我猜，你要找的从来不是一只羊。
Your daughter was here, in Kalindraur.
你的女儿来过这里，就在卡林德劳尔。
Allow me to compose my thoughts. There are memories swirling in my head, looking to settle in place.
容我理一理思绪。脑海里有许多记忆翻涌着，正要各归其位。
I will tell you about the Codex when I can.
等时机合适，我会告诉你们典籍的事。
In the meantime, meet me in the room with the stone platform. We have a visitor.
在此之前，到有石台的房间来找我。我们有位访客。
Things just got a lot more interesting.
Leunamar is not the god of truth. He is truth.
卢纳玛尔不是真理之神。他就是真理。
Kalindraur, though much about it eludes me, is a focus of power and energy reaching out into all Solmaria.
卡林德劳尔——尽管关于它的大部分事我都想不起来——是一处焦点，汇聚着力量与能量。它的影响延伸至整个索尔玛利亚。
Defeating those monsters has unlocked the access point where the Codex can transfer its power.
击败那些怪物，解开了典籍，转移力量的接入点。
Continue on, as always. You will do what is in your nature.
一如既往，走下去吧。你会顺从你的天性行事。
From here, I can use the Codex to free Emerisk from this curse.
从这里，我可以用典籍，将埃梅里斯克，从这诅咒中解放。
Perhaps, even the whole of Solmaria.
也许，连整个索尔玛利亚也能一并解放。
Here is the Mynswar Opal. It was not easy to get.
这是明斯瓦蛋白石。得来可不容易。
Meet me in the southwest chamber, in the room with the stone platform.
到西南边的厅堂来找我，有石台的那间。
The guardian will be joining us.
守护者也会与我们同去。
That was the idea. Perhaps it was even less safe in that place.
本来就是这么打算的。也许那个地方反而更不安全。
Its presence alone... I can feel my memories returning.
仅仅是它的存在……我就能感到记忆在回归。
I can. The Codex is a physical manifestation of Leunamar. He is truth, and power over darkness.
我能。典籍，是卢纳玛尔在世间的具现。他即是真理，是统御黑暗的力量。
My daughter. I sent you to bring the book back to me, and you did. I missed you, even when I did not know why.
我的女儿。我派你把那本书，带回来给我，你做到了。我想念你，哪怕当时我不知为何。
The purity of his spirit led the guardian of this place to call out to him.
他灵魂的纯净，令此地的守护者向他发出了呼唤。
Then, I can go back to being a normal bard?
那么，我能回去当个普通的吟游诗人了？
But why was @ drawn to it?
可 @ 为什么会被它吸引？
这话并不怎么让人安心。
Do you mean to say that we've been travelling with a god?
你是说，我们一路同行的是位神明？
Well, some of us don't know what to go back to.
嗯，我们当中有些人，不知道该回到哪里去。
And you succeeded, my friend. You returned the book.
你成功了，我的朋友。你把那本书，还了回去。
Good, we have questions that need answers.
好，我们有问题需要解答。
Perhaps the guardian led her here as well. I am unsure, but she left on her own. We could not stop her.
也许守护者也把她引到了这里。我不确定，但她是自己离开的。我们拦不住她。
Maybe... I will spend more time with you.
One last thing... I never did find that sheep.
最后一件事……那只羊，我始终没找到。
Then you can tell us about the Codex? Do you know why I was drawn to it?
那你能给我们讲讲典籍，的事了吗？你知道我为什么会被它吸引吗？
I do not even remember her...
